description: This file contains unit tests for the Bigint class in the ZipStream namespace, validating its construction, addition, overflow handling, and hexadecimal representation.

classes.name: BigintTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Bigint class in the ZipStream namespace.

methods.name: testConstruct
methods.description: Tests the construction of Bigint objects and their hexadecimal and 32-bit low/high parts.

methods.name: testConstructLarge
methods.description: Tests construction of Bigint with large values and verifies hexadecimal and byte conversion.

methods.name: testAddSmallValue
methods.description: Tests adding small integers to Bigint and checks low 32-bit value and overflow states.

methods.name: testAddWithOverflowAtLowestByte
methods.description: Tests addition that causes overflow at the lowest byte boundary.

methods.name: testAddWithOverflowAtInteger32
methods.description: Tests addition resulting in overflow past 32 bits and verifies hex and overflow state.

methods.name: testAddWithOverflowAtInteger64
methods.description: Tests addition that overflows a 64-bit boundary and expects an OverflowException.
